title: UK — Brexit Referendum 2016
description: Referéndum sobre salida de UE. Polarización aumentó dramáticamente durante campaña. Resultado 52% Leave vs 48% Remain.
data_notes: P represents leave_vote_share (units: share). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: mean(opinion > 0). At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Leave vote share: P represents the fraction of population with opinion > 0 (Leave = +1, Remain = −1 in bipolar encoding). Observation operator H: fraction of agents with opinion > 0.
